result:
**Verdict: FAIL.** Five of the six round-2 findings are closed; F-DG7-960 stays open. It is a documentation miscount: the release notes say "six" handbacks are missing a section, but the audit finds seven. I raised no new findings, and nothing I ran in the product itself failed.

I reviewed candidate `sha256:60dd90b6…80e9` (source `8323dac`, 3154 files). The ID recomputed correctly at the start and the end; the only commits after the freeze were the other two reviewers' runs, which change nothing outside `docs/delivery`.

**Round-2 findings**

| Finding | Status | What I checked |
|---|---|---|
| F-DG7-915 / 961 (release notes stale) | **Closed** | The release-notes `--check` passes on the frozen files, and the register SHA-256 the notes cite matches the shipped register. Putting back the round-2 notes, or changing one byte of the register, makes the check fail. |
| F-DG7-935 (18 rows SPECIFIED) | **Closed** | Exactly the 18 rows named in D-274 changed, and only their status, evidence and notes. All 412 rows are IMPLEMENTED and the register validator passes. I accept the Q19 extension as an honest disclosure for the 23 marked rows, except the miscount below. |
| F-DG7-960 (handback disclosure) | **OPEN, Medium** | The audit finds 7 DG7 handbacks missing a section. The known-limitations document now says 7, but the release notes and the REQ-DLV-012 register notes still say "six". The seventh, `T-DG7-DO-D8-devops-engineer.md`, has no merge instructions and is not named anywhere; neither D-270 nor D-274 covers it. The fix is to name it in REQ-DLV-012 and regenerate the release notes. It has no effect on product behaviour. |
| F-DG7-962 (integration order dependence) | **Closed** | The test files pass 252/252 in both orders. With the round-2 version of the guard file put back, 9 tests fail. |
| F-DG7-963 (transfer-drill cleanup) | **Closed** | The drill test file passes 55/55, and two deliberately broken versions fail. I also ran a real transfer drill where the cleanup was forced to fail: it still printed PASS, exited 0 and logged one warning. |

**Everything else I ran on this candidate**
- **Static checks:** all pass. `deps:verify` could not run because there is no package registry here (known residual D-057).
- **Unit tests:** 3042, 2199 and 259 passed; 2 skips that only apply to the no-codegen project.
- **Integration:** 474 files, 4692 tests passed; the 8 skips and 1 to-do are explained in the record.
- **Tool test suites:** release 464 of 466 (2 explained skips), deploy 189, gates 66, agents 39, migration 29.
- **Product browser tests:** 286 passed in English and 286 in Arabic. The one keyboard walkthrough that needs demo data passed 2/2 on the demo stack.
- **Acceptance tests A03–A22:** 288 passed, plus the same 18 accessibility-scan skips as earlier rounds. All network connections stayed on the local machine.
- **Offline drill:** 10 of 10.
- **A18 transfer:** an archive built from the frozen commit passed verification, and the harness passed 10/10.
- **A19 restore:** all nine restore checks (R1–R9) passed, and the 13-test restore harness passed.
- **A26:** the known defect was caught by the regression test.
- **A27:** I re-ran the K11 resumption check against the candidate's own `progress.md`, and it passes.
- **Gate validators:** DG0–DG6 historical, the DG7 register rules and reconcile all pass.

**Disclosures**
- **Container host run:** Docker isn't available to me, so I did not re-run it. I judged the orchestrator's host evidence as still applying, because no server, migration, image or Compose code changed since that run.
- **Round number:** the assignment says `round: 7`, but the validator requires it to match the `round-3` folder, so I recorded 3.
- **My own mistake:** my first ordering run failed 4 tests because of how I had linked dependencies between my two copies. With real copies the failures disappeared; those logs are kept.

**Records written**
- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG7/round-3/qa-verifier.json`
- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG7/round-3/qa-verifier.verifications.json`
- `docs/delivery/reviews/DG7/round-3/qa-verifier.md`
- Evidence under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG7/qa/round-3/`; the secret scan of it passes.

No findings sidecar, since there are no new findings. My temporary copies are removed.
